title: Mona Lisa Street Art
description: A stylized pop art portrait of the Mona Lisa rendered in bold black, white, yellow, and orange silhouettes on a white canvas. The painting sits on a surface with visible watercolor palettes and art supplies in the foreground and corners.
prompt: A bold pop art reinterpretation of the Mona Lisa using high-contrast black and white with vibrant yellow and orange accents, stylized geometric shapes in the background, flat graphic areas with visible brush texture, painted on a white canvas with a horizontal yellow band across the lower third, viewed from above with art supplies visible at the edges.
